digest.component_or_area: reconciler bridge and canary workflow scheduling
propositions: Reconciler bridge and canary jobs consume a significant share of the shared GitHub Free runner pool (20 concurrent jobs org-wide) and must reduce their scheduling frequency to halve CI runner contention

Bridge cron schedule must change from 20-minute intervals (*/20) to uniform 40-minute intervals using a three-entry cron cycle over 2 hours, with tests asserting every consecutive gap is exactly 40 minutes

Chain re-dispatch must sleep for the duration of the completed pass before re-dispatching (capped at 900s, skipped above 1800s elapsed, skipped if PASS_STARTED_EPOCH unset or non-numeric) to double the inter-invocation period without consuming new repository variables
Canary schedule must change from hourly (0 * * * *) to 2-hourly (0 */2 * * *) and its staleness alert window must double from 2 hours to 4 hours to preserve the 3x cadence margin
Jenkinsfile must mirror the same three-entry 40-minute backstop cron as GitHub workflows for Jenkins parity

All comments, documentation, and strings referencing the old 20-minute or hourly cadence must be rewritten to reflect new 40-minute and 2-hourly intervals, and grep verification must confirm no old cadence strings remain
